marc:datafield.marc:subfield: John Adair’s 100 greatest ideas for effective leadership

"It is with great pleasure that I offer you my 100 Greatest Ideas on Effective Leadership. Please pluck as many fathers as you like from this collection and make them your own. I hope that they will enrich your personal effectiveness as a leader. This book takes a logical look at those issues which you have to get to grips with if you are able to perform well as a leader. To be successful as leader, you have to be: well organised and disciplined; good at goal setting and focused on objectives; able to think creatively and to make decisions; and able to communicate with other people. The ideas presented here are a distillation of my greatest tried and tested ideas on all these areas and will help you to function better as a leader or manager: able to get results through people and able to understand yourself and others"-- c Provided by publisher.
